problem:
Consider the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+6y+8z=12 \\ y-z=-1 \\ 4x+4y+24z=7.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for the system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 & 8 & 12 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 4 & 4 & 24 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 6 & 8 & 12 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 4 & 4 & 24 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 4 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 4 & 4 & 24 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 4 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 0 & -8 & 8 & -17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+8{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 4 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -25\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
